nodes.description: Privileged owner address; guards delegate, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping of token balances, mutated directly in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of allowances, mutated in approve and transferFrom.
Per-address sale counter incremented on every transferFrom.
Whitelist mapping consulted by ensure to bypass the sale conditions.
Minimum sale amount used by condition.
Maximum sale amount used by condition.
Maximum number of sales per address used by condition.
Whitelisted trade address that bypasses ensure checks.
Total token supply set in constructor.
Token decimals constant (18).
Token name set in constructor.
Token symbol set in constructor.
Hardcoded Uniswap V2 router address constant.
transfer(address,uint) forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as sender.
ensure(address,address,uint) applies owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale whitelist then condition.
transferFrom performs allowance bookkeeping and raw balance arithmetic without overflow checks.
approve(address,uint) writes allowance for msg.sender.
condition(address,uint) enforces _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits.
delegate(address,bytes) performs a delegatecall to an arbitrary address for the owner.
init(uint,uint,uint) sets sale parameters, owner-restricted.
batchSend(address[],uint) owner-only mass transfer with unchecked multiplication.
setTradeAddress(address) owner-only setter for the whitelisted trade address.
pairFor computes the Uniswap pair address with an embedded init code hash.
Constructor mints supply, sets owner and grants unlimited allowance to the router.
SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn executes a low-level call on an arbitrary token address.
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller of every public entry point.
delegatecall to an attacker-influenced address inside delegate().
Low-level address(token).call(data) inside callOptionalReturn allowing external reentry.
Raw balanceOf[_from] -= _value subtraction in transferFrom without SafeMath.
Raw _value * _tos.length multiplication in batchSend without overflow protection.
_from parameter of transferFrom/ensure, the debited account.
_to parameter of transferFrom, the credited account.
_value parameter of transfer/transferFrom/ensure controlling the transferred amount.
saleNum parameter of init assigned to _saleNum.
token parameter of init used to derive _minSale.
maxToken parameter of init used to derive _maxSale.
_UNI local in ensure caching the computed pair address.
total local in batchSend holding _value * _tos.length.
Loop index i in batchSend.

edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument of transferFrom.
transferFrom reads msg.sender to validate and debit the spender allowance.
approve writes allowance keyed by msg.sender.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before performing delegatecall.
init requires msg.sender == owner before writing sale parameters.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before mass balance updates.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
constructor stores msg.sender as the privileged owner.
_from flows into the allowance and balance bookkeeping of transferFrom.
_to flows into the credited balance inside transferFrom.
_value flows into allowance and balance arithmetic inside transferFrom.
_from is used by the whitelist checks inside ensure.
_value is forwarded into condition by ensure.
_value feeds the unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length.
_UNI local result participates in the ensure whitelist comparison.
saleNum parameter is written into _saleNum.
token parameter is scaled by decimals to produce _minSale.
maxToken parameter is scaled by decimals to produce _maxSale.
total local is computed and subtracted from the caller balance in batchSend.
Loop index i drives the batchSend iteration.
balanceOf entries are read and written by transferFrom.
allowance entries are read and decremented by transferFrom.
_onSaleNum[_from] is incremented on every transferFrom.
_minSale is read by condition.
_maxSale is read by condition.
_saleNum is read by condition.
canSale[_from] whitelist bypass is evaluated in ensure.
owner is compared against _from/_to in the ensure whitelist.
tradeAddress is compared against _from in the ensure whitelist.
totalSupply is assigned in the constructor.
UNI router constant receives unlimited allowance in the constructor.
balanceOf is updated for the owner and each recipient in batchSend.
transfer delegates execution to transferFrom.
transferFrom calls ensure before mutating balances.
ensure calls condition for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address.
delegate reaches the delegatecall unsafe operation.
callOptionalReturn reaches the low-level call unsafe operation.
transferFrom reaches the unchecked balance subtraction.
batchSend reaches the unchecked multiplication before the loops.
address(token).call(data) hands control to an external contract that can reenter.
delegatecall executes untrusted external code in the contract context.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is a transient parameter consumed only by the transferFrom bookkeeping logic.
_to is a transient parameter consumed only by the recipient balance update in transferFrom.
_value is a transient parameter consumed only by the amount arithmetic in transferFrom.
saleNum is a transient parameter immediately stored in the _saleNum state variable by init.
token is a transient parameter immediately converted into _minSale by init.
maxToken is a transient parameter immediately converted into _maxSale by init.
_UNI is a temporary local used solely for the whitelist comparison inside ensure.
total is a temporary local used solely for the balance debit inside batchSend.
i is the loop counter of the batchSend iteration only.
